note: Small family campground in a pine-flanked mountain meadow on Silver City Rd off US-385, west of Rapid City in the central Black Hills. Gravel full-hookup pull-throughs and grass water-and-electric pull-throughs, tent sites and camping cabins; heated saltwater pool. No generators. --Claude
